verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's own HyperAgent is documented as an open-source framework that extends Playwright with AI (page.ai, page.extract). That implies it can drive a locally launched Playwright browser, but nothing in the evidence explicitly documents a local-browser mode or use without a Hyperbrowser account. The core platform is otherwise described as managed cloud sessions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running HyperAgent against a local browser, confirmation that no Hyperbrowser cloud account or API key is required, local setup instructions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
